name: Bank Respublika ASC
note: Azerbaijani joint-stock bank (founded 1992). Its shares are held by the Quliyev brothers (Natiq Saday oglu Quliyev 63.32%, Elchin Quliyev 18.46%, Namig Quliyev 8.47%), Shakir Rahimov (5.45%) and Sparkassen International Development Trust (4.22%); no state stake is reported. In September 2026 the bank agreed to acquire 100% of AccessBank, paid in new Bank Respublika preferred shares equal to about 25% of its enlarged charter capital.
